description: Permissions for the Hub window. Tauri v2 denies every core API unless it is granted here — custom commands registered through invoke_handler are always allowed, which is why an app with no capability file appears to half-work: commands succeed while every listen() silently fails and the interface freezes with no error anywhere. The Flow Bar overlay is deliberately NOT included: its capabilities live in overlay.json, scoped to only what its own frontend code calls. See that file for why sharing this one with the overlay was a real gap, not caution.
